findings.text: blocking: deleting benchmarks/carrier_step_attribution.py in e7bd2533 leaves this tracked test importing a module that no longer exists, so the file fails at collection on the edited tree — reproduced for this run in out-of-scope-import.log as an ImportError with EXIT=1 while the same file passed at the base revision; the deletion was justified by a census of benchmark names in docs only, and the live test importer is what makes the module not dead.

follow-on: the shipped plan's plan-artifacts meta still names nova/equilibrium/coefficient_carrier.py, which e7bd2533 deleted, so that plan's declared artifact list now points at a file that does not exist and its owning scope should drop the entry.

follow-on: the log's header records revision=63caf693, the base commit, while the test it exercises exists only in the uncommitted working tree of that moment, so a reader comparing the header revision against the head sha sees a mismatch that the header's absence of a dirty-tree marker cannot explain.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit — 6d00aabf consolidates the dilation and the analytic helpers, e7bd2533 deletes coefficient_carrier.py and its test with the four carrier benchmarks, 20bdab4be adds the evidence fragment; the three commits touch only paths inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for the touched test files measured by delta against the base with no added failures; baseline-suite.log and after-suite.log are the per-file arms it names, and my own parse of those two logs gives 36 baseline and 34 edited failure ids with zero added and the edited set a strict subset of the base set.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to remove the duplicated four-neighbour dilation, the dead coefficient-carrier tooling and the copied test helpers; the diff at 63caf693..20bdab4be does all three — nova/equilibrium/morphology.py:8 now owns the one dilation that nova/equilibrium/wall_mask.py:391 calls, the coefficient-carrier module, its test and four benchmarks are deleted, and tests/conftest.py:21 and tests/conftest.py:33 hold the single copy of each helper.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the three local commits, the five-file CPU gate at 36 baseline and 34 edited failure ids with zero added, names every per-file log with its own revision header, and records a negative_control_log whose last line reads EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's 15 declared write paths; every path in the diff against the base is one of them and no path outside the list appears in any of the three commits.

justifications.durability: tests/test_equilibrium_forward_solve.py:147 derives its expected dilation from an argwhere loop and fails when the false padding is replaced by periodic propagation, which dilation-negative-control.log shows at EXIT=1.
justifications.evidence: baseline-suite.log and after-suite.log carry a revision, a runnable command and per-file summaries, and my own parse of them reproduces 36 to 34 failure ids with zero added.
justifications.fit: tests/conftest.py:21 adds pure helper functions beside the module's fixtures, and three test modules import them, though the neighbouring tests/rotating_equilibrium_references.py shows the repository's shared-module idiom rather than import-from-conftest.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/equilibrium/morphology.py:8 holds one host-and-device dilation that nova/equilibrium/wall_mask.py:391 now calls, which is the consolidation the goal names.
justifications.reuse: nova/equilibrium/morphology.py already owned _dilate4 for nova/equilibrium/stencil_nulls.py:948 and nova/equilibrium/connectivity_boundary.py:646, and the change extends that owner instead of adding a third dilation.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff --name-only 63caf693 20bdab4be is one of the 15 declared write paths, with no figure or file outside that grant.
